title: Cone
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Within this face, draw a single loop consisting of four lines: the first line starts at the origin and ends at coordinates [0.75, 0.0]; the second line starts at [0.75, 0.0] and ends at [0.75, 0.1193]; the third line starts at [0.75, 0.1193] and ends at [0.0, 0.1193]; the fourth line completes the loop by starting at [0.0, 0.1193] and ending at the origin. Apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the transformed sketch 0.0256 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The dimensions of the resulting rectangular base are 0.7499999999999998 units in length, 0.11931818181818181 units in width, and 0.025568181818181816 units in height. The final shape is a cone with a flat base and a pointed top, where the base is wider than the top, and the sides are smooth and curved.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.1193) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.1193) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create a 3D object
r = r.extrude(0.0256)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
